item.title: Arctic ice had been expanding for 1,000 years before reaching its greatest extent around 1960
item.description: A recent study indicates that the Barnes Ice Cap had begun expanding nearly 2,000 years ago. This expansion was attributed to cooler summer conditions that allowed ice to grow. However, rising greenhouse gas emissions reversed this trend and caused significant ice retreat since the 1960s. Researchers emphasize that human-induced warming has disrupted natural climate patterns that favored renewed glacial growth. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: No need to take blood pressure pills now? Scientists are testing a device that can reduce BP by stimulating nerves
item.description: A recent study shows that stimulating the ear can help lower blood pressure. Known as transcutaneous autonomic neuromodulation, this innovative approach may offer an effective solution for managing hypertension. However, further research is essential to validate the efficacy of this non-invasive technique. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
